Step 3. Consider the semidefinite operator \(P_{01370013}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the semidefinite decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|P_{01370013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01370013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through rational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
